# Blueprint

`writing`

A drawing of one structure or station recipe. Reading it teaches the recipe, and the blueprint is kept.

> Share how to build by writing (ResearchSharedByWriting, Phase 203)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| teaches | string | The technology or recipe key it teaches, chosen when written |
| author | string | Player id of the writer |
| rules | json | Writing rule: { teaches, station, cost, consumedOnRead, writerMustKnow } (validated at fabric load) |

## Related

| Name | Kind | Target |
| ---- | ---- | ------ |
| teaches | hasOne | [RecipeHearth](recipehearth.md) |
| decision | hasOne | [ResearchSharedByWriting](researchsharedbywriting.md) |

## Actions

### write

Write a blueprint about something the writer knows

**Conditions:**
- Refused when the writer does not know the content
- Consumes the cost

### read

Read a blueprint and learn what it teaches

**Conditions:**
- The reader learns it; the item is kept, so it can be read again and lent
